The '''Third Alsakan Conflict''' was a war between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] that was part of a large [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of events that began in [[17,000 BBY]]. The conflict opened up around [[14,500 BBY]] with the [[Commenor Run Campaign]], with battlefields on [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Kattada/Legends|Kattada]].

In [[14,450 BBY]], the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy|famed]] [[Alsakan Mosaics]] found in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rucapar]] on Alsakan were destroyed during the [[Cleansing of Rucapar]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The center of the mosaic had been featured at the city square and extended to five equidistant [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Only remnants survived the war.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Another faction, the [[Machinists of Nikato]], [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Third Alsakan Conflict)|defeated]] the rival [[Duros Red Credit Brigade]] and then established an independent pocket state known as the [[Nikato's Bootheel]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] in [[14,300 BBY]].<ref name="EA" />
